checkpoints.title: Bounded LF framing before log grammar
checkpoints.contract: Read one LF-delimited byte line while retaining at most max bytes (1..=4096). Drain an oversized line before the next call; treat a nonempty final unterminated line as a line; propagate I/O errors. CR remains payload at this stage, and UTF-8/record grammar are not yet interpreted.

checkpoints.title: Complete current reference
checkpoints.contract: Complete bounded log grammar, all-record summary, case-sensitive Unicode literal search with immediate LF-normalized output, explicit line/total-byte budgets and I/O failure propagation. CLI --contains and --max-bytes allow large streams without whole-file retention; see the reference README.html for precise policies. This is the final checkpoint, not the earlier framing milestone.
